description: Pairing payloads: draftyak-pair:v1: followed by the unpadded, canonical base64url of the payload's canonical JSON. Each case decodes "text" at the instant "now" (UTC ms). An accepted case gives "payload" and its canonical JSON "json", encoding "payload" gives "text" back, and "hubId" is how the device shows hid. A case with "error" is refused with that code, from the first check that fails: PAIR_PREFIX (the text doesn't start with the exact prefix), PAIR_ENCODING (over 1000 characters, prefix included, not canonical base64url, or not the canonical JSON of a value: invalid UTF-8, a lone surrogate, a byte-order mark, a duplicate member or any other spelling), PAIR_PAYLOAD_INVALID (not exactly the fields hid, addr, pid, sec, exp, name and role in their forms) and PAIR_EXPIRED (exp before now). So a code that fails two checks gets the first one's code. "hubKey" is the test-only P-256 key whose SPKI hash is the cases' hid.
